digest.component_or_area: config-ownership AST gate and approved-seam registry
propositions: AST gate must detect six prohibited config-access categories (ambient env read, helper-shim env read, load_config call, literal-getattr on os.environ, provider-credential read outside boundary, configurable adapter default/backend reload) in non-seam modules and report path/symbol/access-kind/owning-seam diagnostics

Env-read detection and shim resolution must reuse gen_env_registry's scan/KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS/matchers directly without parallel re-implementation, and fail closed on unresolved/dynamic env reads or shim-shaped callees absent from the table

Owner registry must derive credential names from _child_env.owned_secret_names, backend keys from static @register decorator scan (not import-time _REGISTRY), and env baseline from gen_env_registry.scan + _deprecations.REGISTRY(kind=='env'), with drift self-test failing if a newly declared env name has no owner
Receiver-object aliasing must be resolved (e.g. src=os.environ; src.get(key)) and callee aliases (local bindings, imports, import-as forms) must normalize to canonical callees for classification

Approved-seam registry must enumerate two distinct sets (composition roots: */config.py, _config_sources.py, _child_env.py, LLM adapters; provider-credential boundaries: rebar_reconciler runtime/access_check/adapter settings files) and reject path-glob exceptions structurally
Legacy-exception set must cover current below-seam reads as exact path+symbol+rationale entries so gate introduces without product-code changes, with C3 draining to empty
